blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Video large language models incur substantial inference costs from long visual token sequences. Existing video token compression methods mitigate these costs by exploiting spatial redundancy within frames and temporal redundancy across frames. However, many approaches impose predefined processing orders or fixed allocation ratios for spatial and temporal compression, limiting their ability to adapt to the varying balance of spatiotemporal redundancy across videos. To address this limitation, we propose PURA, a training-free method that prunes visual tokens through unified spatiotemporal redundancy assessment. For each token, PURA constructs spatial and temporal reference candidates and selects the reference with the lowest representation error across the two dimensions. The representation error is combined with token importance to determine each token's removal cost. To avoid the time overhead of removing the lowest-cost token one by one, we introduce Coordinated Pruning, which iteratively groups mutually compatible low-cost removals into batches for simultaneous execution and updates the pruning state after each batch until the target budget is reached. Extensive experiments on three video large language models and five video understanding benchmarks demonstrate that PURA achieves a favorable trade-off between task performance and inference efficiency.
blocks.zh: 视频大语言模型从长视符号序列中产生大量推论费用. 现有的视频符号压缩方法通过利用帧内的空间冗余和跨帧的时间冗余来减轻这些成本. 然而,许多方法对空间和时间压缩规定了预先确定的处理命令或固定分配比率,限制了它们适应视频间瞬间冗余的不同平衡的能力。 为了解决这一限制,我们提议采用无培训方法,通过统一的spatiotopal冗余评估来调取视觉符号。 对于每个标志,PURA构建空间和时间参考候选人,并选择两个维度中代表差最小的参考. 表示错误与象征重要性相结合,以确定每个表示物的去除成本. 为了避免一个接一个地去掉最低成本的代号,我们引入了"协调普鲁宁"(Coorded Pruning),它迭代地将相容的低成本清除分成分批进行同时执行,并在每批之后更新普鲁宁状态,直到达到目标预算. 对3个视频大语言模型和5个视频理解基准的广泛实验表明,PURA在任务性能和推断效率之间实现了有利的取舍.

blocks.en:
Video large language models (VideoLLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in video understanding and reasoning [ 18 , 13 , 26 , 31 , 1 , 2 , 27 ] .
However, processing videos typically yields long visual token sequences from numerous frames, imposing substantial computational and memory costs during LLM inference [ 17 , 25 ] . These costs grow with the number of input frames and their spatial resolution, making long and visually detailed videos particularly expensive to process.
At the same time, visual token sequences often contain considerable redundant information. Visual token compression has therefore emerged as a promising approach to reducing inference overhead while preserving model performance [ 4 , 5 , 29 , 33 ] .
blocks.zh:
视频大语言模型(VideoLLMs)在视频理解和推理方面表现出强大的能力[18,13,26,31,1,2,27].
然而,处理视频通常从众多帧中产生长的视觉符号序列,在LLM推论中造成大量的计算和内存成本[17,25]. 这些成本随着输入框的数量及其空间分辨率而增加,使得长长和视觉详细视频的处理特别昂贵.
同时,视觉符号序列往往包含相当冗余的信息. 因此,视觉信号压缩已成为在保持模型性能的同时减少推算间接费用的一种有希望的办法[4、5、29、33]。

blocks.en:
Existing video token compression methods improve efficiency by exploiting spatial redundancy within frames and temporal redundancy across frames. However, many rely on predefined processing orders and manually specified thresholds [ 12 , 23 , 11 , 10 ] , or preset allocation ratios between frame-wise token selection and cross-frame merging [ 24 , 8 ] . These predefined strategies limit the flexibility of spatial and temporal compression, making it difficult to adapt their relative contributions to varying redundancy patterns across videos. This can leave redundancy insufficiently reduced while causing unnecessary loss of informative content.
Recent work [ 7 ] moves beyond separate spatial and temporal stages through global token selection. Because its matching does not explicitly account for spatiotemporal structure, the method may treat visually similar tokens from different events as redundant.
These limitations motivate a structured yet unified compression strategy to jointly exploit spatiotemporal redundancy in each video.
blocks.zh:
现有的视频符号压缩方法通过利用帧内的空间冗余和跨帧的时间冗余来提高效率. 然而,许多人依赖预先确定的处理订单和人工指定的阈值[12,23,11,10],或预先设定的按帧选择符和跨帧合并[24,8]之间的分配比率. 这些预先定义的战略限制了空间和时间压缩的灵活性,使得它们相对的贡献难以适应跨视频的不同冗余模式. 这可能造成冗余不足,同时造成不必要的信息内容损失。
最近的工作[7]通过全球符号选择超越了独立的空间和时间阶段。 由于它的匹配没有明确地说明spatiotopal结构,因此该方法可能将不同事件的视觉类似符号视为多余.
这些限制促使有条理但统一的压缩策略,共同利用每个视频中的瞬间冗余.

(b) Similar visual content within a frame exhibits high spatial redundancy. PURA jointly models both redundancies, favoring temporal pruning in (a) and spatial pruning in (b). Blue and orange × \times markers denote temporal and spatial token removals, respectively.

blocks.en: To this end, we propose PURA, a training-free method that prunes visual tokens through unified spatiotemporal redundancy assessment. PURA first constructs spatial and temporal reference candidates for each token. Spatial candidates include all other tokens within the same frame, while temporal candidates are obtained by dividing the video into temporal segments, linking each token within each segment to its most similar counterpart in the preceding frame, and tracing these links backward to form a temporal chain. The most similar candidate across the two candidate types is selected as the token’s reference, with the feature distance between them measuring the representation error. PURA combines this representation error with token importance, measured by the attention received by the token in the vision encoder, to determine each token’s initial removal cost, providing a unified criterion for jointly evaluating both spatial and temporal redundancy.
blocks.zh: 为此,我们提议采用无培训方法,通过统一的瞬间冗余评估,对视觉标志进行修饰。 PURA首先为每个信物构建时空参考对象. 空间候选者包括在同一框架内的所有其他标志物,而时间候选者则通过将视频分为时间段,将每个部分内的每一标志物与前一个框架中最相似的对应物联系起来,并追溯这些链接后向形成时间链来获得. 这两类候选人中最相似的候选人被选为信使的参考人,他们之间的特征距离测量了代表错误。 PURA将这种表示错误与象征重要性结合起来,以视觉编码器中表示得到的注意来衡量,以确定每个表示物的初始去除成本,为联合评估空间和时间冗余提供了统一标准.

blocks.en: Given these removal costs, greedily removing the lowest-cost token one at a time and updating the pruning state after each removal is time-consuming, yet directly grouping multiple removals into a batch can be problematic because a token’s removal decision relies on its selected reference remaining available. To address this issue, we introduce Coordinated Pruning, which iteratively groups mutually compatible low-cost token removals into batches for simultaneous execution. At each iteration, it preselects a candidate pool of the lowest-cost tokens and scans them in ascending cost order to construct a removal batch, adding a token only if its reference is not in the batch and it is not referenced by any token already selected. These conditions ensure that removing one batch member does not alter the reference or importance of any other member, keeping their removal costs valid for simultaneous removal. After each batch is removed, the importance of removed tokens is transferred to their retained references to preserve the collective semantic contribution of similar tokens. Remaining tokens whose references were removed are then reassigned to their most similar available candidates, and the affected removal costs are recomputed for the next iteration until the target token budget is reached. By executing mutually compatible token removals in batches, Coordinated Pruning substantially reduces ranking and state-update steps while closely approximating sequential greedy pruning.
blocks.zh: 鉴于这些清除成本,贪婪地一次去掉最低成本的标志,并在每次清除之后更新清除状态是耗时的,但直接将多重清除归类为批次可能会有问题,因为一个标志的清除决定取决于其选定的参考文献。 为了解决这一问题,我们引入了“协调执行”,将相互兼容的低成本象征性清除量迭代地分成几批,同时执行。 在每次迭代时,它都会预先选择一个费用最低的代号的候选集合,并按上升成本顺序扫描这些代号,以构建一个移除批次,只有在批次中未提及代号,且未以任何已经选定的代号引用时,才会添加代号. 这些条件确保一个批次成员除名不会改变任何其他成员的参考或重要性,使其除名费用对同时除名有效。 每批去除后,将去除的令牌的重要性转移到其保留的参考文献中,以保留类似令牌的集体语义贡献. 其余的参考文献被删除,然后重新分配给最相似的候选人,受影响的删除费用在达到目标符号预算之前重新计算。 通过分批执行相互兼容的代号清除,协调普鲁宁大大降低了排名和状态更新步骤,同时密切接近相继的贪婪的普鲁宁.

blocks.en:
We evaluate PURA on three video large language models across five video understanding benchmarks.
Across the tested backbones and retention ratios, PURA consistently achieves the highest average scores.
Visualizations in Fig. 2 further illustrate how PURA favors temporal pruning when visual content repeats across frames and spatial pruning when similar regions appear within a frame. Meanwhile, Coordinated Pruning cuts mean compression time across benchmarks from 2435.5 ms to 21.8 ms, enabling end-to-end speedups of 2.53 × 2.53\times at 10% retention and 2.71 × 2.71\times at 5% retention on VideoMME. Overall, PURA achieves the best trade-off between video understanding performance and inference efficiency among the evaluated methods.
blocks.zh:
我们通过三个视频大语言模型来评价PURA,
在整个经测试的骨干和保留比率中,PURA一直达到最高的平均分数。
图2中的可视化进一步说明,当视觉内容跨帧重复时,PURA如何偏向于时间穿梭,当类似区域出现在一个框架内时,则倾向于空间穿梭. 同时,协调推进削减意味着跨基准的压缩时间从2435.5 ms到21.8 ms,使得在VideoMME上,端对端速度达到2.53×2.53\时,保留率为10%;2.71×2.71\时,保留率为5%. 总体而言,PURA在视频理解性能与被评价方法的推论效率之间实现最佳权衡.

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: 1. We identify a limitation of existing video token compression methods: predefined processing orders and fixed allocation ratios restrict their ability to adapt to varying spatiotemporal redundancy across videos. 2. We propose PURA, a training-free video token compression method through unified spatiotemporal redundancy assessment. It builds structured spatiotemporal references per token and combines representation error with token importance into a unified removal cost for adaptive pruning without predefined orders or fixed ratios. 3. We introduce Coordinated Pruning to accelerate sequential greedy pruning. By grouping mutually compatible low-cost token removals into batches, it substantially reduces sequential ranking and state-update overhead. 4. Extensive experiments across three video large language models and five video understanding benchmarks demonstrate that PURA achieves a superior accuracy–efficiency trade-off over existing methods.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献概述如下: 1. 我们查明了现有视频信号压缩方法的局限性:预先确定的处理订单和固定分配比率限制了它们适应不同视频瞬间冗余的能力。 2. 我们提议通过统一时空冗余评估,采用无培训视频信号压缩方法。 它将结构化的spatiotemporal参照每个符号,将表示错误和象征重要性结合起来,形成一个统一的去除成本,用于适应性修炼,而无需预先确定订单或固定比率. 3. 我们引入协调普鲁宁,以加速顺序贪婪的普鲁宁。 通过将相互兼容的低成本象征性清除量分成批次,大大减少了顺序排列和状态更新间接费用。 4. 三个视频大语言模型和五个视频理解基准的广泛实验表明,PULA与现有方法相比,实现了更高的准确性-效率权衡。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Video Large Language Models
blocks.zh: 2.1 视频大语言模型

blocks.en:
Large vision-language models typically connect a vision encoder to a language model through a multimodal projector, enabling joint processing of visual and textual inputs [ 6 , 21 , 36 , 19 , 15 ] . Most video large language models inherit this architecture, extending visual inputs from individual images to sequences of video frames.
LLaVA-OneVision enables transfer between image and video tasks via unified training on single-image, multi-image, and video data [ 14 ] .
LLaVA-Video strengthens video instruction following with synthetic video-language data [ 34 ] , while InternVL3.5 enhances multimodal reasoning through cascade reinforcement learning [ 27 ] .
Alongside these training advances, Qwen2.5-VL improves temporal representation by aligning the temporal component of multimodal rotary position embeddings (MRoPE) with absolute time [ 3 ] .
Qwen3-VL further introduces interleaved MRoPE and textual timestamps to improve spatiotemporal modeling and temporal grounding [ 2 ] .
As video understanding expands to longer videos and finer visual details, processing more frames at higher resolutions produces longer visual token sequences and increases inference latency and memory consumption, motivating efficient visual token compression.
blocks.zh:
大型视觉语言模型通常通过多式联运投影仪将视觉编码器与语言模型连接起来,从而能够联合处理视觉和文字输入[6、21、36、19、15]。 大多数视频大语言模型继承了这种架构,将视觉输入从单个图像扩展到视频帧的序列.
LLaVA-One Vision通过统一培训实现图像和视频任务之间的转移,这些培训涉及单一图像、多图像和视频数据[14]。
LLaVA-Video通过合成视频语言数据加强视频教学[34],而InternVL3.5则通过级联强化学习加强多式联运推理[27].
除了这些培训进展外,Qun2.5-VL通过将多式联运旋转位置嵌入(MROPE)的时间部分与绝对时间[3]相配合,改善了时间代表。
Qune3-VL进一步引入了互页的MROPE和文本时间戳,以改善瞬间模型和时间定位[2].
随着视频理解扩展至更长的视频和细微的视觉细节,在更高分辨率下处理更多的帧会产生更长的视觉符号序列,并增加推论纬度和内存消耗,激发高效的视觉符号压缩.

blocks.en: 2.2 Video Token Compression
blocks.zh: 2.2 视频托肯压缩

blocks.en:
Video token compression exploits redundancy within and across frames to reduce inference costs.
FastVID prunes within temporal segments [ 24 ] , whereas UniComp uses informational uniqueness for frame fusion and token allocation [ 30 ] .
HoliTom and STTM follow predefined merging orders [ 23 , 12 ] , while FrameFusion performs cross-frame merging before importance-based pruning [ 10 ] .
FlashVID presets the allocation ratio between frame-wise selection and cross-frame merging [ 8 ] .
However, these methods rely on predefined pipelines or separate budget allocation for different compression operations.
Du et al. [ 7 ] rank tokens by attention and compare the top k k against a global retention pool without explicitly accounting for spatiotemporal structure.
In contrast, PURA constructs structured references from same-frame tokens and temporal correspondences, and defines a unified removal cost using importance-weighted representation error to balance spatial and temporal pruning.
To accelerate this process, Coordinated Pruning executes mutually compatible low-cost removals in batches, transferring importance and updating affected references after each batch to guide later pruning.
blocks.zh:
视频令牌压缩利用帧内和跨帧冗余,以减少推论成本.
FastVID prunes into Time parties [24] ,而UniComp则使用信息独有性来进行帧聚变和符号分配 [30].
HoliTom和STTM遵循预先定义的合并指令[23, 12],而FrameFusion则在基于重要性的浏览前进行跨帧合并[10].
FlashVID预设帧选择与跨帧合并之间的分配比例[8].
然而,这些方法依赖于预先定义的管道或不同的压缩操作的单独预算拨款.
杜等编. [7] 通过注意排序符号,并将最高kk与全球留存池进行比较,但没有明确说明瞬间结构。
相比之下,PURA从同帧符和时空函证中构建了结构化的引用,并用重要加权的表示误差定义了统一的去除成本,以平衡空间和时空的挤压.
为加快这一进程,协调运行分批执行相互兼容的低成本清除,转移重要性,并在每批之后更新受影响的参考,以指导以后的运行。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Overview of PURA.
blocks.zh: 图3 : PURA概览。

blocks.en: 3.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 概览

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 3 , PURA is a training-free method that prunes N N visual tokens encoded from a video to a target budget of K K tokens for the language model in two stages. Unified Spatiotemporal Redundancy Modeling constructs spatial and temporal candidate sets for each token, selects the most similar candidate as its reference, and weights the representation error by token importance to obtain an initial removal cost. Coordinated Pruning iteratively executes batches of mutually compatible low-cost token removals and updates the pruning state after each batch until K K tokens remain. Finally, the retained token representations are refined with information from removed tokens.
blocks.zh: 如图3所示,PURA是一种无培训方法,将N N视觉符号从视频编码成K符号的目标预算,分两个阶段用于语言模型. 统一Spatiotemporal Redundancy Modeling为每个代号构建了空间和时间候选集,选择最相似的候选集作为参考,并以象征性重要性来权衡表示错误,以获得初始清除成本. 协调的 Pruning 迭代执行批次的相互兼容的低成本符号清除,并在每批后更新符号状态,直到 K 符号保留. 最后,保留的信使表示用从删除的信使中的信息加以改进。

blocks.en: 3.2 Unified Spatiotemporal Redundancy Modeling
blocks.zh: 3.2 统一间谍冗余模式

Let 𝒜 \mathcal{A} denote the set of retained tokens, initialized with all N N visual tokens, and let f i f_{i} denote the frame index of token i i . For spatial candidates, we consider all other retained tokens in the same frame as token i i . To construct temporal candidates, we first obtain a frame embedding by averaging all token embeddings in each frame. We divide the video into temporal segments by placing a boundary wherever the cosine similarity between adjacent frame embeddings falls below a threshold. Within each segment, we construct temporal links between adjacent frames by matching each token in the later frame to the most similar token in a local neighborhood centered on the corresponding spatial position in the preceding frame. Following these temporal links backward from token i i forms its temporal chain, and 𝒯 ⁡ ( i ) \mathcal{T}(i) denotes the set of earlier tokens reached along this chain. blocks.en: 3.3 Coordinated Pruning
blocks.zh: 3.3 坐标运行

blocks.en: Given the initial removal costs defined above, a straightforward strategy is to greedily remove the token with the lowest current cost and update the pruning state after each removal. However, reaching the target budget requires N − K N-K sequential steps, making this strategy time-consuming for long token sequences. To reduce this overhead, we introduce Coordinated Pruning, which selects mutually compatible low-cost removals and executes them in batches.
blocks.zh: 鉴于上述初步清除成本,一个直接的策略是贪婪地以最低的当前成本去除标志,并在每次清除之后更新螺旋状态。 然而,达到目标预算需要N - K N - K顺序步骤,使这一战略对于长符号序列来说耗费时间. 为了减少这种间接费用,我们引入了"协调普鲁宁"(Coorded Pruning),它选择了相互兼容的低成本清除并分批执行.

blocks.en:
At each iteration, we preselect the M M lowest-cost candidates from the remaining tokens based on their current removal costs. We then construct a removal batch ℬ \mathcal{B} by scanning these candidates in ascending cost order, starting from an empty batch. A token is added only if (1) its chosen reference is not already in ℬ \mathcal{B} and (2) it is not used as a reference by any token already in ℬ \mathcal{B} . These conditions ensure that removing one batch member does not alter the reference or importance of any other member, keeping their removal costs valid for simultaneous execution. Tokens that fail either condition are skipped and reconsidered in subsequent iterations. The scan stops when all M M candidates are examined or | ℬ | = min ⁡ ( B max , | 𝒜 | − K ) |\mathcal{B}|=\min(B_{\max},|\mathcal{A}|-K) with batch limit B max B_{\max} , after which the selected tokens are removed together.
Preselecting the M M lowest-cost candidates avoids a full sort of the remaining tokens. A larger B max B_{\max} reduces iterations by permitting more removals before cost updates, which may increase deviation from sequential greedy selection.

blocks.en: After removing the tokens in each batch, we update the importance, references, and removal costs of the remaining tokens to guide the next pruning iteration. Although individual tokens may have low importance, a group of similar tokens can collectively represent semantically important content. We therefore transfer the importance of removed tokens to their selected retained references, so that their importance continues to influence subsequent pruning decisions. Specifically, at iteration t t , let ℬ j \mathcal{B}_{j} denote the tokens in the current batch whose chosen retained reference is j j . We add their accumulated importance to j j : I j ( t + 1 ) = I j ( t ) + ∑ i ∈ ℬ j I i ( t ) . I_{j}^{(t+1)}=I_{j}^{(t)}+\sum\nolimits_{i\in\mathcal{B}_{j}}I_{i}^{(t)}. (3) The retained reference thus carries the accumulated importance of the tokens it represents, so subsequent removal costs reflect their combined contribution.

blocks.en: Since similarities between tokens remain unchanged during pruning, a chosen reference remains the most similar available candidate as long as it is retained. We therefore select a new reference only when the previous one is removed, choosing the remaining candidate with the highest cosine similarity. We recompute removal costs only for tokens whose importance or chosen reference has changed, using Eq. ( 2 ) with the current importance and reference, while reusing the costs of unaffected tokens. Based on the updated removal costs, we then preselect the M M lowest-cost remaining candidates for the next pruning iteration. This process repeats until K K tokens remain.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: Table 2 : Performance comparison of token compression methods on InternVL3.5-8B and LLaVA-Video-7B with 64 input frames.
blocks.zh: 表2: InternVL3.5-8B和LLaVA-Video-7B上的符号压缩方法与64个输入帧的性能比较.

blocks.en:
Datasets and Models. To evaluate the effectiveness of PURA, we conduct experiments on three representative video LLMs: Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct [ 2 ] , InternVL3.5-8B [ 27 ] , and LLaVA-Video-7B [ 34 ] .
We test all three models across five widely used video understanding benchmarks: VideoMME [ 9 ] , LongVideoBench [ 28 ] , MLVU [ 35 ] , MVBench [ 16 ] , and EgoSchema [ 22 ] . These benchmarks span a wide range of video durations and task types, enabling a comprehensive evaluation of our method.
blocks.zh:
数据集与模型. 为了评价PULA的有效性,我们对三个具有代表性的视频LLMs进行了实验: Qune3-VL-8B-指示[2],InternVL3.5-8B[27],LLaVA-Video-7B[34].
我们测试所有三个模型 跨越五个广泛使用的视频理解基准: VideoMME [9],LongVideo Bench [28],MLVU [35],MV Bench [16],和EgoSchema [22]. 这些基准涵盖广泛的录像时间和任务类型,从而能够对我们的方法进行全面评估。

blocks.en:
Compared Methods. We compare PURA against five recent video token compression baselines.
HoliTom [ 23 ] applies spatiotemporal compression prior to the LLM and merges similar tokens inside the LLM.
FlashVID [ 8 ] performs tree-based spatiotemporal token merging, while UniComp [ 30 ] leverages informational uniqueness to guide token allocation and spatial compression.
V-CAST [ 20 ] utilizes trajectory curvature to allocate frame budgets and dual anchors to select spatial tokens.
Finally, we denote the method of Du et al. [ 7 ] as Unified, which performs global token selection by jointly considering attention scores and similarities to the entire retention pool.
blocks.zh:
比较方法。 我们比较了PURA与最近5个视频符号压缩基线.
HoliTom [23] 在LLM之前应用spatiotemporal压缩,并在LLM内部合并类似的符号.
FlashVID [8] 执行基于树的spatiotemporal符符合并,而UniComp [30] 利用信息独有性来指导符符符分配和空间压缩.
V-CAST [20]利用轨迹曲率来分配框架预算和双锚来选择空间符号.
最后,我们表示杜等人的方法. [7]作为United,它通过共同考虑注意力分数和与整个保留池的相似性来进行全球符号选择.

blocks.en:
Implementation Details. All evaluations use lmms-eval [ 32 ] , with uniformly sampled video frames.
Following FlashVID [ 8 ] , we adopt its hybrid compression setting and align the layer-averaged token budget for fair comparison.
The initial token importance I i ( 0 ) I_{i}^{(0)} is computed from the vision encoder’s final layer.
Throughout our experiments, we set the temporal segmentation threshold to 0.85 0.85 and use a 7 × 7 7\times 7 neighborhood in the preceding frame for temporal linking.
For Coordinated Pruning, we set M = 1024 M=1024 and B max = 512 B_{\max}=512 .
More details are in the appendix.

blocks.en: 4.1 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.1 主要成果

blocks.en:
Table 1 compares visual token compression methods on Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct using 64-frame video inputs across four retention ratios. PURA achieves the highest average score at every retention ratio and consistently ranks first on all five benchmarks. Its advantage becomes more pronounced at lower retention ratios, improving the retained performance over the strongest baseline by 1.5, 2.9, 5.2, and 6.3 percentage points at 20%, 10%, 5%, and 1% retention, respectively. Moreover, PURA’s average score at 5% retention (63.5) surpasses all baselines at 10% retention (62.2–63.2), achieving superior performance with only half the retained visual tokens.
Notably, PURA substantially outperforms Unified across all four retention ratios, supporting the use of structured spatiotemporal references over unconstrained global token matching.
blocks.zh:
表1比较了Quen3-VL-8B-Instruct上使用64帧视频输入的视觉信号压缩方法,涉及4个保留比例. PURA在每个保留率上都达到最高的平均分数,并始终在所有五个基准上排名第一。 其优势在较低留存率方面更加明显,使留存业绩高于最强基线,分别提高了1.5、2.9、5.2和6.3个百分点,分别达到20%、10%、5%和1%。 此外,PURA的5%保留率(63.5)的平均得分超过了10%保留率(62.2-63.2)的所有基线,只保留了一半的视觉标志,实现了优异的表现。
值得注意的是,PURA的绩效大大超过 在所有四个保留率中统一,支持使用结构化的瞬间参照,而不是不受限制的全球符号匹配。

blocks.en:
Table 2 further evaluates PURA on InternVL3.5-8B and LLaVA-Video-7B using 64-frame video inputs at 20% and 10% visual token retention.
PURA continues to achieve the highest average score across both models and retention ratios.
On InternVL3.5-8B, PURA retains 98.1% and 96.5% of the uncompressed performance at 20% and 10% retention, outperforming the strongest baselines by 1.1 and 1.7 percentage points in retained performance, respectively.
On LLaVA-Video-7B, PURA retains a near-lossless 99.3% of the uncompressed performance at 20% retention and 97.6% at 10%, exceeding the strongest baselines by 0.9 and 1.1 percentage points, respectively.
Overall, PURA delivers consistent gains, demonstrating strong generalization across diverse model families and retention ratios.

PURA继续实现模型和保留率最高的平均得分。
在INNVL3.5-8B上,PURA保留了未压缩性能的98.1%和96.5%,保留率分别为20%和10%,在保留性能方面分别比最强基线高1.1和1.7个百分点。
在LLaVA-Video-7B上,PURA保留了近乎无损的99.3%的未压缩性能,保留率为20%,保留率为10%的97.6%,分别超过最强基线0.9和1.1个百分点.
总体而言,普雷维拉协定取得了持续的成果,表明在不同的模范家庭和保留率方面得到了有力的概括。

blocks.en: 4.2 Frame Scaling under a Fixed Token Budget
blocks.zh: 4.2 固定托肯预算下的框架放大

blocks.en:
Table 3 evaluates how PURA scales to more input frames on Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct.
We test 256 and 512 input frames at 25% and 12.5% retention, respectively,
keeping the visual token budget processed by the LLM consistent with the uncompressed 64-frame baseline.
At 256 frames, all three methods outperform the 64-frame baseline on average, with PURA leading at 105.1% of the baseline performance.
When the input is expanded to 512 frames, FlashVID and V-CAST show no further overall gains, with their relative performance dipping slightly from 102.2% to 102.1% and from 103.0% to 102.5%, respectively.
In contrast, PURA continues to improve, reaching 105.7% of the baseline performance.
This advantage is particularly pronounced in long-video understanding, where denser temporal sampling helps capture informative events that sparse sampling may miss.
By effectively utilizing this temporal information, PURA with 512 frames achieves 113.6% of the uncompressed 64-frame baseline’s score on VideoMME Long, exceeding the 107.7% and 105.9% achieved by FlashVID and V-CAST, respectively.
These results suggest that jointly modeling spatial and temporal redundancy helps PURA adapt to the increased cross-frame redundancy in denser frame inputs.
blocks.zh:
表3评价了聚氨酯在Qune3-VL-8B-Instruct上如何缩放到更多输入帧.
我们测试了256和512个输入框,分别为25%和12.5%。
保持LLM处理的视觉符号预算与未压缩的64帧基线一致.
在256帧中,所有三种方法均优于64帧基线,而PURA在基准性能中占105.1%。
当投入扩大到512帧时,FlashVID和V-CAST没有显示进一步的整体收益,它们的相对性能分别从102.2%到102.1%和103.0%到102.5%略微下降.
相比之下,PURA继续得到改善,达到基线业绩的105.7%。
这一优势在长视频理解中尤为明显,在长视频中,密度更大的时间采样有助于捕捉到少量采样可能错过的信息性事件.
通过有效使用这一时间信息,拥有512帧的PURA在VideoMME Long上实现了未压缩64帧基线分数的113.6%,分别超过了FlashVID和V-CAST的107.7%和105.9%。
这些结果表明,联合模拟空间和时间冗余有助于PURA适应密度更大的框架投入中更大的跨框架冗余。

blocks.en: 4.3 Component Ablation
blocks.zh: 4.3 构成部分

blocks.en:
Tables 5 and 5 present progressive component ablations across backbones and budgets on Qwen3-VL-8B (5% retention) and LLaVA-Video-7B (10% retention).
Starting from a spatial-only baseline based solely on representation error, we successively add attention-based importance weighting, importance transfer, feature merging, and temporal pruning, with each variant retaining the preceding components.
Attention-based importance weighting improves the average score by 1.3 points on both backbones, confirming that attention weights effectively reflect the relative importance of visual tokens.
Building on this configuration, importance transfer brings further gains of 1.0 and 0.4 points on Qwen3-VL-8B and LLaVA-Video-7B, respectively, showing that transferring importance to retained references preserves the collective contribution of similar tokens.
Feature merging subsequently adds 0.2 and 0.3 points, respectively, by fusing removed tokens into their retained references to mitigate information loss.
Finally, incorporating temporal pruning boosts the average score by 0.9 and 0.7 points, respectively, highlighting the benefit of unified spatiotemporal redundancy modeling in video token compression.
blocks.zh:
表5和表5列出了Qune3-VL-8B(5%保留)和LLaVA-Video-7B(10%保留)在骨干和预算中的累进部分。
从仅基于表示误差的空间基准开始,我们相继增加了基于注意力的重要性权重、重要性转移、特征合并和时间穿插,每个变体保留前面的成分。
基于注意力的重要性权重使两个骨干上的平均分数提高了1.3分,证实了注意力权重有效反映了视觉符号的相对重要性.
基于这种配置,重要性转移给Qune3-VL-8B和LLaVA-Video-7B分别带来1.0分和0.4分的进一步收益,表明将重要性转移至保留参考书会保留类似符号的集体贡献.
特性合并随后分别增加了0.2分和0.3分,在保留参考文献中添加去除的符号,以减轻信息损失。
最后,纳入时间冲压将平均分数分别提升0.9分和0.7分,凸显了视频符号压缩中统一时空冗余模型的好处.

blocks.en: 4.4 Inference Efficiency Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.4 推论效率分析

blocks.en: Table 6 : Efficiency on VideoMME using Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct with 64 input frames. All times are reported in ms.
blocks.zh: 表6:使用Qwen3-VL-8B-指令框的VideoMME的效率,共64个输入框. 所有时间都以毫秒计报.

blocks.en:
Table 6 evaluates inference efficiency on VideoMME using Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct with 64 frames. All measurements are taken on a single NVIDIA RTX 5090 GPU with a batch size of 1.
The results show that PURA achieves a favorable accuracy–latency trade-off with modest compression overhead.
At a 10% token retention ratio, PURA reduces prefill latency to 221 ms and end-to-end latency to 1393 ms for 10.79 × 10.79\times and 2.53 × 2.53\times speedups over Vanilla, retaining 97.8% of Vanilla’s score at 65.4 and achieving both lower overall latency and higher accuracy than most competing baselines.
This latency advantage largely stems from its 31 ms compression stage, which is faster than FlashVID (52 ms), HoliTom (74 ms), and UniComp (216 ms), and 16.4 × 16.4\times faster than global pool selection in Unified (509 ms).
Relative to V-CAST, the fastest competing baseline, PURA improves the VideoMME score by 3.9 points with only 2.3% additional end-to-end latency.
At a 5% token retention ratio, PURA further reduces prefill latency to 131 ms and overall latency to 1299 ms, achieving 18.21 × 18.21\times and 2.71 × 2.71\times speedups while maintaining a VideoMME score of 63.5.
Despite retaining half as many tokens, PURA achieves higher accuracy and lower end-to-end latency than all competing compression methods evaluated at 10% retention.
blocks.zh:
表6使用64帧的Qune3-VL-8B-指令来评价VideoMME的推论效率. 所有测量均采用单NVIDIA RTX 5090 GPU,批量尺寸为1.
结果显示,PULA在压缩费方面实现了一种有利的准确性-相对性权衡。
在10%的象征性保留率中,PURA将预填空闲时间降低到221 ms,端对端空闲时间降低到1393 ms,以10.79×10.79\时和2.53×2.53\时的速度超过瓦尼拉,将瓦尼拉的97.8%的分数保留在65.4,并且达到总体空闲时间和准确度均低于大多数相互竞争的基线。
这种耐久性优势主要源于其31ms压缩级,比FlashVID(52ms),HoliTom(74ms)和UniComp(216ms)快,16.4×16.4\时间比United(509ms)全局池选择快.
相对于竞争速度最快的基准V-CAST,PURA将VideoMME得分提高3.9分,仅增加2.3%的端对端间歇.
以5%的象征性保留率,PURA进一步将预填空闲时间降至131 ms,总体空闲时间降至1299 ms,在保持VideoMME积分63.5的同时,实现18.21×18.21\时间和2.71×2.71\时间的加速.
尽管保留了一半的令牌,但PURA的精度和端到端的耐久度都比所有以10%的保留率评价的竞相压缩方法要高.

blocks.en: Table 7 : Ablation of reference candidates, spatiotemporal budget allocation, and pruning order on Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct.
blocks.zh: 表7:参考候选人人数、临时预算分配以及Qune3-VL-8B-Instruct上的命令。

blocks.en: 4.5 Ablation of Reference Candidates, Spatiotemporal Allocation, and Pruning Order
blocks.zh: 4.5 参考候选人分配、配偶分配和普鲁宁令

blocks.en:
Table 7 evaluates reference candidates, spatiotemporal allocation, and pruning order on Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct at 5% token retention, with all variants sharing the same removal cost and state-update rules.
We also include Spatial-Only (63.0), which disables temporal references in full PURA.
For reference candidates, Global considers all other retained tokens across the video, akin to the global candidate pool in Unified [ 7 ] , whereas Segment-Wide augments the same-frame candidates with all retained tokens from every other frame in the same segment.
Notably, Global (62.3) falls 0.7 points below Spatial-Only, whereas PURA achieves 63.9, outperforming Global by 1.6 points and confirming the benefit of structured spatiotemporal references over unconstrained global candidates.
PURA also outperforms Segment-Wide (63.2) by 0.7 points while requiring fewer temporal similarity computations through sparse local chains, achieving better pruning performance with lower matching complexity.
To examine spatiotemporal allocation, we record each video’s temporal removal share ρ v \rho_{v} in full PURA, defined as the fraction of token removals that use temporal references.
Global Level and Benchmark Level average ρ v \rho_{v} across all videos and within each benchmark, respectively, to set fixed removal quotas. Both variants use joint cost-based pruning until either quota is met, then restrict further removals to the other dimension.
Their mean scores of 62.8 and 62.9 fall slightly below Spatial-Only and trail PURA by 1.1 and 1.0 points, respectively, highlighting the benefit of adapting removal proportions to each video.
To examine pruning order, Temporal First and Spatial First use PURA’s exact per-video spatial and temporal removal quotas, but exhaust one quota before switching to the other dimension.
Even with matched quotas, Spatial First (62.6) falls below Spatial-Only, and PURA outperforms Temporal First (63.2) and Spatial First by 0.7 and 1.3 points, respectively, highlighting the benefit of jointly pruning tokens with low removal cost across both dimensions.
blocks.zh:
表7评价参考候选人,spatiental分配,以及Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct上以5%的象征性留置量的奔跑顺序,所有变体都分担相同的移除费用和状态更新规则.
我们还包括仅空间部分(63.0),该部分完全禁止在普雷利亚语中提及时间。
对于参考候选人,Global在整个视频中考虑所有其他保留标志,类似于United[7]的全球候选人人才库,而Spart-Wide则用同一部分中所有其他框架的所有保留标志来增加同一框架的候选人。
值得注意的是, " 全球 " (62.3)比 " 仅空间 " (Space-Only)低0.7点,而 " 普林斯顿 " (PURA)则比 " 全球 " (Global)高63.9点,并证实有条理的 " 瞬间 " 参考比不受限制的全球候选人有利。
PURA还比部分-Wide(63.2)差0.7分,同时要求通过稀少的局部链进行较少时间相似度的计算,以更低的匹配复杂性实现更好的运行性能.
为了检查spatiotemporal分配,我们将每个视频的时间删除份额 ^ v\rho_{v} 完整记录在 PURA 中, 定义为使用时间引用的象征性删除的一小部分 。
Global Level和Basic Level的平均值 à v\rho_{v )分别覆盖所有视频和每个基准内设定固定删除配额. 两种变式都采用基于成本的联合计算方法,直到达到任何一种配额,然后将进一步清除限制在另一个方面。
其62.8和62.9的中分分别略低于Space-Only和跟踪PULA的1.1和1.0分,凸显了根据每段视频调整删除比例的好处.
为了检查排查顺序,Temporal First和Space First使用PURA精确的每个视频时空清除配额,但在转换到另一个维度之前用尽了一个配额。
即便有相应的配额,空间第一(62.6)仍低于空间唯一(63.2),而PULA的绩效分别高于临时第一(63.2)和空间第一(1.3),突出表明了在两个维度上共同推移成本低的代币的好处。

blocks.en: Table 8 : Ablation of batch limit B max B_{\max} in Coordinated Pruning on Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct. Results averaged over five benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 表8: Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct上协调运行的批量限制B Max B_{\max}。 成果平均超过五个基准。

blocks.en: 4.6 Ablation of Pruning Batch Limit
blocks.zh: 4.6 刷新批量限制

blocks.en:
Table 8 reports the effect of the batch limit B max B_{\max} in Coordinated Pruning on Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct at a 5% token retention ratio, averaged over all five benchmarks.
Larger batch limits accelerate token compression but increase selection deviation from sequential greedy pruning, as measured by the proportion of non-overlapping retained tokens.
Nevertheless, the mean accuracy remains highly stable from 63.3% to 63.5% across all tested batch limits.
At B max = 512 B_{\max}=512 , compression latency drops from 2435.5 ms to 21.8 ms, achieving a 111.7 × \times speedup with only a 1.1% token difference and a slight accuracy gain to 63.5%.
Further increasing B max B_{\max} to 1024 marginally reduces latency to 19.0 ms while tripling the token difference to 3.3%.
Given these diminishing returns, we set B max = 512 B_{\max}=512 by default to balance compression efficiency and selection consistency.
blocks.zh:
表8以5%的象征性保留率报告了在协调普鲁恩对Qune3-VL-8B-Instruct的批量限制B max max} , 在所有五个基准中的平均保留率。
较大的批量限制加速符号压缩,但会增加选择偏差从顺序的贪婪挤压,以非重叠保留符号的比例来衡量.
尽管如此,在所有经过测试的批量限值中,平均精度仍然高度稳定,从63.3%到63.5%。
B 最大值 = 512 B ××××× 512,压缩时速从 2435.5 ms降至 21.8 ms,实现111.7 ×\ 时速加速,只有1.1%的象征性差值,精度略有提高,达到63.5%.
将B 最大 B max 进一步提升到 1024 将延迟 略微降低到 19.0 毫秒,同时将象征性的差值提升至 3.3% 。
鉴于这些递减的回报,我们默认设置了B max = 512 B max = 512,以平衡压缩效率和选择一致性.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we propose PURA, a training-free framework for video token compression via unified spatiotemporal redundancy assessment. By jointly evaluating structured spatial and temporal references with importance-weighted representation error, PURA adaptively balances spatial and temporal pruning without predefined orders or fixed quotas. Moreover, Coordinated Pruning removes mutually compatible tokens in batches, greatly reducing sequential ranking and update overhead. Experiments across three VideoLLMs and five benchmarks show that PURA consistently outperforms prior methods, especially under low token budgets. Overall, PURA achieves a favorable trade-off between task performance and inference efficiency.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们提出PURA,一个通过统一的spatiental冗余评估进行视频符号压缩的无培训框架. 通过联合评估结构化的空间和时间参照,加上重要加权的表示差错,PURA在没有预先确定的命令或固定配额的情况下,适应性地平衡了空间和时间推移。 此外,协调普鲁宁在批次中移除了相互兼容的符号,大大降低了顺序排名,更新了间接费用. 三项VideoLLM和五项基准的实验表明,PULA的业绩一贯高于以往的方法,特别是在低额预算下。 总的来说,PURA在任务业绩和推断效率之间实现了有利的权衡。
